guitar.modelsText: Lowden/Sheeran signature model (Little Lula) and Martin LX1E (Little Martin)
models: Sheeran signature model (Little Lula) and Martin LX1E (Little Martin)
guitar.evidence: Ed Sheeran is closely identified with his small Martin LX1E ('Little Martin') travel guitar and later his Sheeran by Lowden signature models; widely documented.

tone.summary: A clean signal chain using a compressor, followed by a low-gain clean amp (US Deluxe or Silver Twin) and a small cab/IR to emphasize the natural attack of fingerpicked arpeggios.

rig.name: Ed Sheeran - The A Team - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up any background noise from the acoustic source.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean tones.

blocks.purpose: Provide light compression to even out the dynamics of fingerpicked arpeggios and enhance string attack.
blocks.gap: None. Essential for acoustic folk pop tone.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and natural; no distortion needed.
blocks.gap: N/A. The source material is acoustic.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a clean, articulate acoustic sound suitable for folk pop.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is generally used for electric guitar. However, its clean voicing and clarity make it the best choice among available amps to simulate an acoustic/DI tone.

blocks.purpose: Provide a clear and focused cabinet sound that complements the clean US Deluxe amp model.
blocks.gap: While dedicated acoustic cabs are ideal, the US 2x12 offers sufficient clarity for this genre's requirements.

blocks.purpose: Slightly boost the high end and low-mids to enhance string clarity and definition.
blocks.gap: None. Standard tonal shaping for acoustic fingerpicking.

blocks.purpose: No filtering or wah effect needed for the dry acoustic tone.
blocks.gap: N/A. The sound must remain natural and uncolored.

blocks.purpose: Avoid heavy modulation to maintain the dry, natural feel of the performance.
blocks.gap: N/A. Modulation would distract from the core acoustic sound.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle sense of space without sounding lush or distracting.
blocks.gap: The goal is 'very little ambience.' A very low mix and short time setting are used to mimic natural room reflections rather than a noticeable echo.

blocks.purpose: Provide the absolute minimum amount of natural ambience (room tone) without sounding lush or wet.
blocks.gap: The 'very little ambience' requirement dictates a very low mix and short decay time, making this more of an air enhancer than a true reverb effect.

blocks.purpose: Final level control to ensure the signal is balanced for the FRFR output.

improvements.summary: Replace the generic IR with a dedicated acoustic or small room simulation IR for better realism.

proposals.reason: Enhance natural string attack and reduce artificial cabinet coloration.
